meta.name: scope
meta.description: Assess a new customer request against agreed scope, trade-offs and ownership. Use when an engagement expands or a custom feature needs a commitment decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估新需求是否超出约定范围,给出取舍与归属判断
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户临时加需求,你需要判断该不该答应。
copy.tagline_en: Judge whether a new customer request fits the agreed scope before you commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a client keeps adding requests and you must decide what to commit

howto.what: 面对客户新需求时,它会对照已约定的范围、取舍与归属做评估,判断是否值得承诺,并区分实现、验证、部署与验收。若由 @fde 调用,会复用其现有脱敏信息包与范围,不重新开始。
howto.when: 当合作范围扩张,或某个定制功能需要做出承诺决定时接管。

say.text: 客户想加个定制功能,帮我判断是否超出原定范围
say.note: 会对照已定范围、取舍与归属给出评估

say.text: 这个需求要承诺吗?列一下取舍和责任人
say.note: 输出承诺决定所需的取舍与归属

say.text: 把这次范围扩张记下来,分出实现、验证、部署和验收
say.note: 按任务上下文契约记录并区分四类状态

howto.what_en: Given a new customer request, it assesses it against the agreed scope, trade-offs and ownership, helps you decide whether to commit, and separates implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance. Called by @fde, it reuses that packet and scope.
howto.when_en: Use when an engagement expands or a custom feature needs a commitment decision.

say_en.text: A customer wants a custom feature; check if it's outside the agreed scope
say_en.note: Assesses against scope, trade-offs and ownership

say_en.text: Should we commit to this request? List the trade-offs and owner
say_en.note: Gives trade-offs and ownership for the decision

say_en.text: Record this scope expansion, split by implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance
say_en.note: Records per the task context contract
